name: Viridia
description: The Viridian elves' homeland, where Glissa is tried.

description_citations.text: "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves, learn Lyese is alive, and are tried by a tribunal that acquits Glissa; Lyese attacks and all three fall.
timeline.quote: The council quickly decides that Glissa is not guilty, but Lyese takes her acquittal poorly and attacks.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "After the Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aerophin and thousands of Levelers attack; Glissa destroys the aerophin and Lyese reluctantly saves her sister's life.
timeline.quote: Lyese, having woken up and not willing to lose more family, reluctantly saves her sister's life.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Reunion with Bruenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
